newsitem.title: USA: FSA qualifies eight muni bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA qualifies eight muni bond issues for insurance.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said Monday it qualified for bond insurance the following eight municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Downers Grove, Ill., $8.175 million general obligation bonds.
--Pickford Public Schools, Mich., $4.875 million school bonds.
--Bemidji Independent School District No 31, Minn., $8.19 million GOs.
--Lakeville, Minn., $2.025 million GOs, $13.4 million GO and revenue bonds, and $2.2 million GOs.
--Albuquerque, N.M., $18.345 million taxable refunding revenue bonds.
